Read live 2026-09-19: Peacock's app mounts only when reached the way a person reaches it - a deep link (location.href) into a fresh document to /watch/playback/live, a channel address or /watch/profiles leaves the navigation bar and nothing else; from a mounted home the app's own links route fine. So no address is ever handed to Peacock for live: the screen becomes the service and the script walks the route. Live channel addresses in videoLive are the guide's, not a channel's. 2026-10-06, live channels: a break inserted on a live channel never takes adBreakActive (an AFV channel ad went unveiled). The player polls an ad-tracking address (.../v1/tracking/...) every 4 s, whose reply lists each break (avails: startTimeInSeconds + durationInSeconds, and each ad's start) on the same clock as the video's currentTime. The adapter reads those replies as the page receives them (observe only, no request of its own) and calls it a break while the main video's time is inside one.
